title: The Chart That Needed a Denominator
fact_notes: 人物・制度・具体的な出来事・データは架空の教材例・思考実験。実在の調査・統計・法令・技術基準・実証結果を示すものではない。制作台帳は来歴確認用。

sentences.en: A health education teacher prepared a fictional dataset showing the number of students who visited two school health rooms during a particular month.
sentences.ja: 保健教育の教師はある月に二つの学校保健室を利用した生徒の数を示す架空のデータを用意した。

sentences.en: The first school recorded more visits than the second, and several students immediately concluded that the first school had a greater health problem.
sentences.ja: 第一の学校は第二より利用回数が多く、何人かはすぐ第一の学校の健康問題が大きいと結論づけた。

sentences.en: The teacher asked what additional information would be necessary before drawing such a conclusion from the displayed totals.
sentences.ja: 教師は表示された合計からその結論を導く前にどんな追加情報が必要か尋ねた。

sentences.en: She explained that the example was designed to develop data literacy rather than make a statement about any actual school.
sentences.ja: この例は実在校について述べるのでなくデータ読解力の育成を目的とすると説明した。

sentences.en: One student suggested finding out how many students attended each school because their populations might be very different.
sentences.ja: ある生徒は学校規模が大きく違うかもしれないので各校の在籍数を調べることを提案した。

sentences.en: Another asked whether the records counted individual visitors or every separate visit, since one person might return several times.
sentences.ja: 一人が数回利用することもあるため、記録は個々の利用者を数えるのか毎回の利用を数えるのかと別の生徒が尋ねた。

sentences.en: A third pointed out that the two health rooms might offer different services or have different opening hours.
sentences.ja: 三人目は二つの保健室でサービスや開室時間が異なる可能性を指摘した。

sentences.en: The teacher encouraged the class to distinguish the recorded events from the conclusions they wished to reach.
sentences.ja: 記録された事象と導きたい結論を区別するよう促した。

sentences.en: The class received an expanded version of the fictional dataset containing enrollment figures and definitions of the recorded categories.
sentences.ja: 在籍数と記録区分の定義を含む架空データの拡張版を受け取った。

sentences.en: Students calculated the number of visits in relation to enrollment, rather than comparing the totals alone.
sentences.ja: 合計だけを比較せず在籍数に対する利用回数を計算した。

sentences.en: They found that the relative picture could change when the size of each student population was taken into account.
sentences.ja: 各校の生徒数を考慮すると相対的な状況が変わり得ると分かった。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, even the revised comparison could not identify why students had visited or whether their health had improved.
sentences.ja: それでも修正比較から利用理由や健康状態の改善は分からなかった。

sentences.en: For their final report, the students designed a chart that clearly described both the numerator and the denominator of each calculated rate.
sentences.ja: 最終報告で各算出率の分子と分母を明確に示すグラフを設計した。

sentences.en: They included a note explaining that visits were not necessarily equivalent to the number of different people using the facility.
sentences.ja: 利用回数は必ずしも施設を利用した異なる人数と同等でないという注を加えた。

sentences.en: They also replaced a dramatic headline with a more limited description of what the chart actually measured.
sentences.ja: 劇的な見出しを実際にグラフが測定したものについての限定的記述に置き換えた。

sentences.en: The teacher praised their willingness to leave questions unanswered when the available information did not support definite conclusions.
sentences.ja: 入手情報が明確な結論を支えない場合に問いを未解決のまま残す姿勢を評価した。

sentences.en: The exercise illustrates that numerical accuracy alone is not sufficient for responsible interpretation of health information.
sentences.ja: この練習は数値の正確さだけでは健康情報の責任ある解釈に十分でないと示す。

sentences.en: A calculation may correctly describe a particular rate while failing to answer a broader question about the circumstances behind it.
sentences.ja: 計算は特定の率を正しく表しても背後の状況についてのより広い問いに答えられないことがある。

sentences.en: Readers should examine what was counted, what was used as a basis for comparison, and which questions remain outside the scope of the data.
sentences.ja: 何が数えられ、何が比較の基準で、どの問いがデータの範囲外か検討すべきだ。

sentences.en: The goal of the activity was not to discover which fictional school was healthier, but to recognize what evidence would be needed to investigate that question responsibly.
sentences.ja: 目的はどちらの架空校がより健康か見つけることでなく、その問いを責任を持って調査するために必要な証拠を認識することだった。

vocabulary.definition: ability to understand and use information
numbers of people in defined groups

questions.prompt: What did the fictional dataset show?
options: Health room visits at two schools.

questions.prompt: What was premature about the students' conclusion?
options: It treated a larger total as proof of a larger health problem.
questions.explanation_ja: 合計だけで健康問題を判断。

options: The number of teachers in the country.
The number of students at each school.
One person may be counted on multiple visits.
The two terms always mean exactly the same count.
The percentage of students absent nationally.
questions.explanation_ja: 在籍数に対する利用回数。

questions.prompt: What did the adjusted comparison still not establish?
options: Reasons for visits or health outcomes.
The names of the fictional schools.
questions.explanation_ja: 理由や健康改善までは不明。

questions.prompt: What did the new chart specify?
options: The exact cause of every visit.
To guarantee greater attention at all costs.
To claim that one school was healthier.
To describe what was actually measured.
questions.explanation_ja: 実際の測定内容に合わせる。

options: A bigger count always indicates worse health.
Every numerical result answers all relevant questions.
Responsible data interpretation requires knowing what is counted and what conclusions the data support.
Health room visits measure identical people.
questions.explanation_ja: 測定対象と結論の限界を理解。

grammar.focus: since one person might return several times
even the revised comparison could not identify
grammar.explanation_ja: evenで修正後も限界があると強調。

grammar.focus: while failing to answer a broader question

paraphrases.source: The teacher asked what additional information would be necessary before drawing such a conclusion from the displayed totals.
paraphrases.rewrite: She asked what information was needed before reaching a conclusion based on totals.

paraphrases.source: Another asked whether the records counted individual visitors or every separate visit, since one person might return several times.
paraphrases.rewrite: One student asked whether repeated visits by the same person were counted separately.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 同一人の反復利用を区別。

paraphrases.source: Nevertheless, even the revised comparison could not identify why students had visited or whether their health had improved.
paraphrases.rewrite: The adjusted figures still revealed neither reasons for visits nor health improvement.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 補正後も理由・改善は不明。

paraphrases.source: A calculation may correctly describe a particular rate while failing to answer a broader question about the circumstances behind it.
paraphrases.rewrite: A rate can be calculated accurately yet leave broader questions unanswered.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 率の正確さと解釈の限界。

discourse.role_ja: 複数利用の可能性が理由。
